resolved_questions.question: Do the reviewed test credentials establish a committed operational secret?
resolved_questions.resolution: No. Credential-shaped values in tests are explicit synthetic literals, repeated characters or mocked tokens. Reviewed documentation refers to ignored credential locations without including their values.

resolved_questions.question: Do the bundled collection fixtures contain live field/person records or executable payloads?
resolved_questions.resolution: The inspected manifests, XML, attachments and in-memory decoded SQLite rows identify authored synthetic samples/emulator cohorts. Supplied ZIP members were read as data; duplicate content was checked by hash. No operational credentials or executable payload were observed in these fixture contents.

resolved_questions.question: Do the supplied editable forms use macros, external workbook links or embedded credentials?
resolved_questions.resolution: Both XLSX packages were inspected through every XML member, with identical members matched by bytes and differing members read. They contain worksheet strings, formatting, internal relationships and XLSForm settings; no macro or external relationship was present. The two XForms were fully inspected through the reviewed version-2 archive and the complete byte comparison/diff to version 1.

resolved_questions.question: Does default root container configuration publish its API directly to all host interfaces?
resolved_questions.resolution: Root compose publishes 3000 and 8000 only on 127.0.0.1. Dockerfile selects UID 10001 after build. Ignore rules exclude private/environment material from build and deployment inputs. This resolves the root-default configuration question only; deployed compose is another reviewer's scope.

resolved_questions.question: Does the vendored demo insert imported remote data into HTML?
resolved_questions.resolution: The reviewed live-app.js constructs an in-memory seeded demo. Its editable predicate/value are displayed via an esc helper in text positions. Attribute interpolations use internally generated entity/merge IDs. No remote/network source is implemented there; no attacker-to-script sink was established.

resolved_questions.question: Does the active root dependency lock fetch packages from a credential-bearing or non-registry custom URL?
resolved_questions.resolution: All 179 root lock package records and top-level metadata were read. Registry packages use HTTPS registry.npmjs.org resolved URLs and integrity values; the single workspace link resolves to web. No credential-bearing/custom package URL was observed. This was source inspection, not an advisory or installed-package audit.

unresolved_questions.question: Can an untrusted application caller control WorldModel namespace while enabling local persistence?
unresolved_questions.detail: EventStore builds .world/<namespace>.json using path.join without constraining namespace. Library configuration is caller-controlled; no attacker-reachable caller was established in this assigned scope. Parent was asked to verify bridge callers, which are owned by another reviewer. Do not report this as a confirmed vulnerability without that reachability.
